a.text: Pointless obsession, pointless struggle, pointless sacrifice... you have been fearful for centuries.
You divided my awakening into hundreds of cycles, each of which is subdivided by twelve, then subdivided by thirty, and then...
You live in constant fear every minute, every second, fearing the time limit, though you do not know when it will come...
Have 'I' become so foolish and shortsighted in the span of just a few dreams?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Without a will, without a self, without someone to measure and define it, time is no more than a cycle without meaning...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: As the time you spent in the tomb was.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: How do you define this time, if you neither think nor feel?

a.text: A dream hysterical for its inevitable end?

steps.name: Determined Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: The mounts, seas, and all in between shall be our master's!

steps.name: Yanese Border Force
steps.text: Heresy!

steps.name: Determined Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Yanese Border Force
steps.text: Drop your weapon and live!

steps.name: Determined Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Drop my weapon?

steps.name: Determined Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: We will teach the House of Yan that Ju has awakened, and their reign is no more than a fleeting dream compared to the infinity of heaven and earth!

steps.name: Determined Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: The mounts, seas, and all in between shall be—

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: Come, drink!

steps.name: Overwhelmed Soldier
steps.text: Sir, I'm just a humble soldier—

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: Don't sell yourself short!

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: After centuries, we've finally eliminated the last remnant from that hunt! The lands of Yan are safe now!

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: A toast to all of you!

steps.name: Overwhelmed Soldier
steps.text: Thank you, sir!

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: And to the two of you, of course.

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: Mr. Shuo inspired the troops by always being the first to charge into the fray, while Mr. Wang's tactics were utterly flawless.

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: The bulk of the credit for taking down Ju must go to the two of you.

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: A toast to you.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: ...Duoxie.

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: This is a rare opportunity, Mr. Wang, and there is something I must say to you.

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: I know of the slanders against your name in the imperial court, casting suspicions upon you because you are not one of our kind.

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: But you have endured such slanders and made a historic contribution to Yan. Your noble heart is admirable.

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: To interfere even in family reunions... the Sui Regulator's restrictions on you are unreasonable.

steps.name: Tipsy Commissioner
steps.text: I will petition to His Majesty to permit your family gathering...

steps.name: Drunken Commissioner
steps.text: It's a joyful day. I consider myself a strong drinker, but it appears wine has gotten the best of me...

steps.name: Drunken Commissioner
steps.text: To tell the truth, my orders were to... keep an eye on you and make sure nothing goes wrong.

steps.name: Drunken Commissioner
steps.text: But the two of you have proven yourself... utterly loyal... most respectable!

steps.name: Drunken Commissioner
steps.text: This is as far as I go... take care!
The drunken official manages a farewell and departs, helped by his bodyguards.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: A good man, but a poor spy.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Did you think about what will happen to all of us if he finds out what you did?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You are drunk.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I wish I were drunk, and all this was naught but a dream.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Why did you let the beastial Ju go?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Best to have a card up one's sleeve.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Who is your opponent this time?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You must feel it. We all do... It is awakening, much sooner than the one thousand years that we expected.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: We need help.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Did Ju promise to help you defeat Sui?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: It is too weak to even protect the Shanhaizhong, and we have not gotten to that point. It is not time yet.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I told you. There are other ways to escape Its influence—

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I know what you're going to say. You finally cleaned up the ties between you and It. You wanted 'Me' to no longer be 'Us', and 'We' no longer be 'It'...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: And you, you sealed 'Yourself' away in the sword...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: What then? Did the Sui Regulator return your sword?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: We still live in shackles...

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: True shackles do not come from outside—

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Do you really believe that everyone can be like you?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You remember everything and care about everything. People, events, and things from centuries past have all flowed away like the great river, but Shuo remains Shuo, always.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Not everyone can be like you...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: How long would it take for Dusk to become like you? What about Yu? Do you really want Yu to be like you?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: A thousand years is not enough, and we don't even have a thousand years.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: We don't have time.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I'm hardly your equal in weiqi, but I know that when there is no clear path to victory in sight, it is better to play in a straightforward manner, than to attempt radical tricks without a plan.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Do you think there is no victory in this game? That you would be content with doing all the right things in an honorable defeat?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I never said that...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Your plan will have no other outcome.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: What do you think we should do, then?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: If you truly found a path, tell me, and I will come with you—our chances would be better that way.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Just tell me what the chances are. You can use me however you want. I would be happy to give my life.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: But do you really know what you're doing?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Or has your obsession with victory blinded you to risks and consequences?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Tell me.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Say something.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Did you consider it?!
The proxy slams his palm on the stone table—or so he intended to.
But he has yet to adapt to his mortal vessel, and he misjudged both the strength and position.
A deep crack appears on the weiqi board that Wang always carries with him.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Wang, I—

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Impressive, brother. This human body you created for yourself can still split boulders.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Listen to me!

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: No, thank you.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: None of us could reach your heights, brother. You need not trouble yourself with our fates.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Wang!

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Had a fight with our eldest brother? Such is written all over your face.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I get drunk by the roadside for a couple of hours, and the two of you are already making trouble.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: If you have anything to say to him, you can say it to him directly.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Come now, there is no need for that.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I know what you were fighting over. Sui.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: This is not the first time you have fought over this. Can you not accept your differences?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: This is a matter of life and death. It's not something that can be glossed over so easily.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Would you keep fighting, even when the end comes?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Run not from the words that need to be said. The longer you delay this, the greater the problem grows.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Not today.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Wang... now, now, come back—

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Weiqi failure! Can you not act your age? Playing the brat in front of your younger sister?
Ling leads the way while Wang slowly follows behind.
They see the eldest proxy still sitting by the pavilion.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Dage. Our biggest brother.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Little Ling...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I have told you, calling me 'Little Ling' makes me feel like a child.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Sorry. Old habits die hard.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: So it would seem.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Hmph, smashing things in your rage? Are you the child here?

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: I'll fetch some good wood and make a new one for you.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Or would you prefer to keep this one? I can ask Nian or Yi to fix it, when they're here...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Oh... I recall the days when I had freshly awoken, watching you two fight amongst yourselves, time after time.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I remember the Candleholder asking me anxiously...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: 'How bad will it get when all your younger siblings are born? Please, give me an estimation so that I can report to the court and get a disaster response plan set up!'

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: An idea, Dage: Let me speak to Wang, alone.

spans.text: Let me speak to Wang, alone.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I will serve as your messenger this time, in order that you need not break anything else.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: ...Very well.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: So, about the weiqi board...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: Just leave it, brother. I'll repair it myself. No need to trouble yourself.

steps.name: Shuo
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You are still angry.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I'm not.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You only address him as 'brother' when you are angry.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: What were you arguing about? Tell me.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: It is just as I thought.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: His way is the proper way, but it is slow. If It were to suddenly awaken one day, it would all be too late.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: As for you... *sigh*

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: If you want to argue with him, should you not at least come up with a plan of your own?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: He gave up his sword to prove our innocence, the sword that means so very much to him. Do you feel no gratitude?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Are you perhaps... seriously furious that he smashed your board?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: I'm just frustrated by his lack of urgency.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: We all seek a way. Dusk has even fewer ideas. Does she anger you too?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Its awakening is accelerating. We are all anxious, and it is understandable that we might provoke the occasional quarrel with inadvertent words.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: But it will take centuries for It to awaken. Maintaining a cordial relationship with Yan is the more pressing matter.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Or are you saying that I, too, lack urgency?

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: No... that's not what I mean.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: You said we're all looking for a way.

steps.name: Wang
steps.text: What are you looking for?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Your ears have merit.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: It and I, we are all nothing but a dream.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: This is just the seed of an idea, and I know not how far I can go.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: But I hope to leave behind a dream.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: A dream that It cannot disturb, even if It has fully awakened.
